_readme: Hand-edited. One entry per photo the site uses: alt = what the photo shows (used wherever it carries meaning), position = CSS object-position focal point used when the photo is cropped. Responsive sizes are generated by `npm run images` into data/image-manifest.json.

/images/gorilla.jpg.alt: A mountain gorilla sitting among ferns and moss in the misty Bwindi rainforest

/images/lion.jpg.alt: A male lion resting on the branch of an acacia tree at sunset

/images/safari.jpg.alt: Guests in a safari vehicle watching a herd of elephants on the savannah at sunset

/images/waterfall.jpg.alt: Murchison Falls thundering through a rocky gorge, with a safari lodge on the cliff above

/images/lodge.jpg.alt: Thatched safari lodge suites on stilts overlooking the savannah at sunset

/images/social/elephant-mother-and-calve.alt: An elephant mother with two calves walking through green savannah grass

/images/social/murchison-nile-cruise.jpg.alt: A tour boat on the Nile heading toward Murchison Falls between forested hills

/images/social/rwenzori-margherita-peak..alt: A climber holding an ice axe beside the Margherita Peak sign, the highest point in Uganda

/images/social/safari-vehicles-at-the-ni.alt: Safari vehicles parked in a line beside the river

/images/social/uganda-passport.jpg.alt: A hand holding a Ugandan passport beside an aeroplane window
